corrections.text: The headline pairs "Two Malicious VS Code Themes" with "Thousands of Installs". Socket's post says the wider cluster of themes has "thousands of installs" and gives "more than 8,000 Visual Studio Marketplace installs" for Coca-Cola Christmas and Aurora Borealis Studio Theme, which it describes as "not currently weaponized". Socket gives no install count for the two confirmed malicious extensions.

The article describes Socket's link to GlassWorm as covering both malicious themes and says it is "not a confirmed attribution by the campaign's original investigators"; no source says the latter. Socket's "high confidence" GlassWorm assessment applies to the Visual Studio Marketplace build of Cosmic Nebula Themes, based on the same Solana dead-drop address, AES key and publisher namespace as previously documented GlassWorm activity. Socket calls the broader cluster, including Aurora Nocturne Night Theme, "GlassWorm-associated".
